title: From spend dashboard to a funded savings plan
description: Eight quarters of spend, one category drill-down, and four ranked savings initiatives traced back to the underlying purchase orders. All data is synthetic.

steps.notes: Canvas-heavy screen for the M1 capture set: the chart is captured as a rasterised image, which is what the extension produces for a <canvas>.

tooltip.title: Charts survive the capture
tooltip.body: This visualisation is drawn on a canvas in the live product. The capture rasterises it into the snapshot, so it renders identically on a laptop with the wifi switched off.

tooltip.title: Coverage is the lever, not the total
tooltip.body: Instruments run at 62% on contract with nine suppliers. That gap is where the savings sit — and it is one click from the transactions that produced it.

tooltip.title: One supplier off contract, 14.6% of the category
tooltip.body: Acme Excipients is buying at list on ₹ 31.4L of spend. Nothing was rekeyed to find that — it falls out of the PO and contract data.

tooltip.title: Turn the finding into a plan
tooltip.body: Ranked opportunities, with the effort each one actually takes.

tooltip.title: ₹ 33.1L, ranked by value and effort
tooltip.body: Every line traces back to the purchase orders and contract lines behind it, so the number survives a conversation with finance.

endScreen.headline: ₹ 33.1L of savings, evidenced down to the purchase order
endScreen.body: Synthetic data on a demo tenant. Opportunity models are tuned to your categories and contract structure.
